recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中紅系前驅細胞明顯增生，箭頭指出的大型前驅細胞具圓形開放染色質與單一明顯核仁（類巨母紅血球樣 megaloblastoid erythroid precursors），並可見有絲分裂；H&E 無法顯示環狀鐵粒母細胞，因此只能支持紅系異常增生，需以鐵染色確認 RARS。
features: Hypercellular marrow with many erythroid precursors showing round, dark, condensed nuclei
Arrowed large precursors with round nuclei, open chromatin and single prominent central nucleoli, consistent with early/megaloblastoid erythroid cells
Admixed granulocytic precursors and interstitial hemorrhage/proteinaceous material
No Prussian blue stain; ring sideroblasts not assessable
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy section shows a hypercellular marrow with prominent erythroid precursors, including arrowed large early erythroid cells with round nuclei, open chromatin and single prominent nucleoli, suggestive of megaloblastoid maturation. Occasional mitoses and admixed granulocytic precursors are present. Ring sideroblasts cannot be assessed on H&E; a Prussian blue stain on the aspirate is needed to document the ring sideroblasts required for MDS with ring sideroblasts, and exclusion of an acute erythroid leukemia requires quantitative assessment.

ddx.vs: Pure erythroid leukemia shows sheets of proerythroblasts (at least 30%) with erythroid cells over 80% of the marrow, rather than scattered early precursors.
Megaloblastic anemia shows giant metamyelocytes and hypersegmented neutrophils with low B12/folate and responds to replacement.
Parvovirus produces giant proerythroblasts with glassy intranuclear viral inclusions and a paucity of maturing erythroid cells.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma or large cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: Metastatic cells form cohesive clusters with different immunophenotype, whereas these cells blend into an erythroid maturation sequence.
